# Libarchive (RAR read-only subset)

Vendored from [libarchive 3.7.7](https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive/releases/tag/v3.7.7).

Yume compiles a read-only subset that enables the RAR and RAR5 readers
only. Encrypted RAR is detected and rejected; Yume never uses official
UnRAR sources. License: BSD-2-Clause / BSD-3-Clause, see `COPYING`.
